answer: No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Proof sells at 166 POA a piece; the farm's 186 pieces lock 30876 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each pearl white is a firing record witnessed by the kiln master, and that is why Clay carrier pearl white proof glazed at the firing chamber guards the door. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the sonnet is the pass, the vine is the fare, the velvet is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price.
